projects.name: NoRisk Client
projects.description: NoRisk Client is a custom Minecraft Client and launcher with over 3k daily active users with cosmetics, minigames, hosted worlds and more!
projects.longDescription: NoRisk Client is a custom Minecraft Client with over 3k daily active users. It provides an extensive set of features e.g. securely hosting singleplayer worlds publicly via a custom proxy, play minigames like tetris against other players and useful in-game HUD overlays.

projects.name: GalaxyBot
projects.description: GalaxyBot is a Discord Bot with over 3.8M users centered around support systems and advanced team management.

projects.name: auth-rs
projects.description: auth-rs is a custom from scratch OAuth2 and OIDC compatible identity provider complete with 2FA and webauthn passkeys written in Rust and Svelte.

projects.name: Local Media Listener
projects.description: A kotlin library that provides a simple way to subscibe to media changes on any device, by loading custom dlls that access the OS level media APIs.

projects.name: Spotify Overlay
projects.description: A Minecraft mod that provides an in-game overlay of your current playing Song. Data that is displayed is provided by the Local Media Listener library.

projects.name: Portfolio
projects.description: My personal website and portfolio, built using Next.js and Tailwind CSS and MagicUI.
